profiles.name: xredis_command
profiles.description: Caller-buffer binary RESP command encoding; no networking, reply decoding or external-client parity claim

profiles.name: xredis_reader
profiles.description: Bounded RESP2/3 streaming events; no owned reply builder, networking or external-client parity claim

profiles.name: xredis_reply
profiles.description: Owned scalar/metadata/streamed replies including allocation, traversal, double conversion and release; no network/parity claim

profiles.name: xredis_client
profiles.description: Closed-loop local TCP peer, 2 workers, pipeline 16; API-to-observation latency includes encoding/queueing but no open-loop or Redis/Hiredis parity claim

profiles.name: xredis_client_init
profiles.description: Serial cold HELLO3 AUTH plus SELECT against a local fixture; handshake includes encoding/worker/TCP/reply observation, lifecycle rate also includes peer/engine create/retire; not production throughput or parity

profiles.name: xredis_openloop
profiles.description: Fixed absolute arrivals with bounded observer slots; all planned offers retained, successful and all-outcome latency separate, generator lag and rejection/timeout visible; local fixture, unpinned

profiles.name: xredis_openloop_stats
profiles.description: Same fixed-arrival workload with XRT memory statistics enabled; whole-process window includes local peer and retirement, separate from uninstrumented latency

profiles.name: xredis_openloop_stall
profiles.description: Controlled initial generator stall; expired planned arrivals must remain in accounting, no client throughput acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_openloop_hold
profiles.description: Controlled held ECHO replies force bounded observer-capacity rejection and request timeout; fault-path accounting, no throughput acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_dial_numeric
profiles.description: Serial cold setup against deterministic DNS/TCP/HELLO fixture; includes factory-to-ready observation, lifecycle includes Engine/Resolver/peer create and join; no OS DNS or production/parity claim

profiles.name: xredis_dial_host
profiles.description: Serial cold setup against deterministic DNS/TCP/HELLO fixture; includes factory-to-ready observation, lifecycle includes Engine/Resolver/peer create and join; no OS DNS or production/parity claim

profiles.name: xredis_dial_addresses
profiles.description: Serial cold setup against deterministic DNS/TCP/HELLO fixture; includes factory-to-ready observation, lifecycle includes Engine/Resolver/peer create and join; no OS DNS or production/parity claim

profiles.name: xredis_dial_host_stats
profiles.description: Serial cold setup against deterministic DNS/TCP/HELLO fixture; includes factory-to-ready observation, lifecycle includes Engine/Resolver/peer create and join; no OS DNS or production/parity claim; separate process allocation instrumentation

profiles.name: xredis_tls_openloop
profiles.description: TLS1.3 AES128GCM/X25519 fixture with explicit custom fixture trust; Fixed absolute arrivals with bounded observer slots; all planned offers retained, successful and all-outcome latency separate, generator lag and rejection/timeout visible; local fixture, unpinned

profiles.name: xredis_tls_openloop_stats
profiles.description: TLS1.3 AES128GCM/X25519 fixture with explicit custom fixture trust; Same fixed-arrival workload with XRT memory statistics enabled; whole-process window includes local peer and retirement, separate from uninstrumented latency

profiles.name: xredis_tls_openloop_stall
profiles.description: TLS1.3 AES128GCM/X25519 fixture with explicit custom fixture trust; Controlled initial generator stall; expired planned arrivals must remain in accounting, no client throughput acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_tls_openloop_hold
profiles.description: TLS1.3 AES128GCM/X25519 fixture with explicit custom fixture trust; Controlled held ECHO replies force bounded observer-capacity rejection and request timeout; fault-path accounting, no throughput acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_tls_auth_cold
profiles.description: Sequential actual TLS1.3 RSA client-certificate connect/HELLO3/PING/physical-close cycles; independent OpenSSL verifies each proof. Fixture and key import excluded; not steady-request throughput or production latency acceptance. Python ssl and cryptography are required only for the fixture.

profiles.name: xredis_transaction
profiles.description: Sequential staged MULTI/two-command queue/EXEC on a two-worker local C fixture; initialization excluded, peer work included; no real Redis/parity or fixed-arrival acceptance claim

profiles.name: xredis_transaction_ordinary
profiles.description: Identical ordinary raw-client pipeline with the optional transaction feature selected; isolates selected request metadata/branches, not managed control validation or transaction execution; unpinned runs are diagnostic only

profiles.name: xredis_watch
profiles.description: Full WATCH/read/commit/physical retirement cycle against a local C peer; no independent performance parity or production acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_watch_ordinary
profiles.description: Identical raw-client pipeline with optional WATCH selected; isolates selected owner pointer/admission branches, not WATCH runtime. Unpinned runs diagnostic only.

profiles.name: xredis_pool_ordinary
profiles.description: Identical raw pipeline with optional pool selected; measures selected private owner/quota branches only, without a live lease or actual quota contention

profiles.name: xredis_pool_managed
profiles.description: Identical compiled managed pipeline; mode 0 selects direct native managed calls or a held exclusive lease. Acquisition/return separately measured; no performance acceptance.

profiles.name: xredis_pool_leased
profiles.description: Identical compiled managed pipeline; mode 1 selects direct native managed calls or a held exclusive lease. Acquisition/return separately measured; no performance acceptance.

profiles.name: xredis_pool_cycle
profiles.description: Complete warm pool checkout/PING/physical-return/observer-release cycle; connection and pool construction excluded and remain separately counted cold costs

profiles.name: xredis_pool_transaction
profiles.description: Full warm pooled session/physical return cycle, different client and pool workers; no production/performance acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_pool_watch
profiles.description: Full warm pooled session/physical return cycle, different client and pool workers; no production/performance acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_pool_connect
profiles.description: Full warm native lease cycles and forced physical repair cycles, including TCP/HELLO and bounded retry; no production acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_pool_connect_sustained
profiles.description: Longer matched fixed/automatic warm cycles for controlled CPU placement; 100000 warm cycles and 1000 physical repair cycles; not production acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_tracking
profiles.description: Closed-loop literal peer: query plus invalidation, feature-selected observation off/on at depths1/32; whole loopback allocation and offer-to-collection latency, excluding setup/shutdown

profiles.name: xredis_caching
profiles.description: Adjacent one-request CACHING/query groups versus two observed async requests from one serialized producer; same loopback wire and logical pipeline, whole-pair offer-to-collection latency and heap costs; no upstream or production claim

profiles.name: xredis_pubsub
profiles.description: Already-owned view cost separately from full parse/view/lifetime and typed versus generic control encoding; no networking or subscribed runtime claim

profiles.name: xredis_subscriber
profiles.description: Native subscription ACK plus independently owned message; closed-loop local fixture, warm registry and bounded pipeline; not upstream/fixed-arrival/native production acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_subscriber_notify
profiles.description: Message-only bounded bursts; initial ACK excluded, server enqueue to owned consumption with complete binary/FIFO checks; shared Future/batch versus polling and one-item transfer, not fixed-arrival or production qualification

profiles.name: xredis_subscriptions
profiles.description: Cold desired edits and allocation-free immutable snapshot references; O(current entries) reference-vector merge, no unchanged-name payload copies; no network or production performance claim

profiles.name: xredis_subscription_session
profiles.description: Whole end-to-end live edit or actual peer EOF to restored native current, including queue and1ms jitter policy; whole-loopback heap; no fixed-arrival or production qualification

profiles.name: xredis_role
profiles.description: Owned ROLE validation+iteration, full parse/lifetime and cursor-only costs; no network/production tail claim

profiles.name: xredis_role_client
profiles.description: Validated-role setup from admission through readiness/verification, including worker/network wait and loopback peer parsing; engine/fixture construction and physical cleanup are outside timing; no production tail claim

profiles.name: xredis_sentinel
profiles.description: Offline cold discovery workload includes local peer/engine creation and physical teardown; smoke evidence only, not service latency or production acceptance

profiles.name: xredis_sentinel_pool
profiles.description: Native lease business traffic after discovery; compare ordinary and Sentinel-maintained pools over identical loopback peers, include queue/observation wait; allocations include peers and mechanical tails
